title: Cyrus and the Machine
author: Marguerite Brightwater
blurb: Lior Whitlock, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
